scope: Disposable POSIX state-format compatibility, not full host or Windows acceptance

formats.v1: PR141 checkpoint version 1 plus committed event tail
formats.v2: PR145 checkpoint version 2 plus channel records and durable post outcomes

requiredAssertions: Actual released send and acknowledgment migrate through actual v1 and v2 brokers
Compatible restart returns original direct retry outcome and channel post outcome
Channel copies retain separate IDs and independent acknowledgment state
Released reader refuses intact v1/v2 without changing any log byte
v1 reader refuses v2 intact or torn without changing any log byte
Released reader with newer committed prefix and torn suffix removes only the uncommitted suffix before refusal
Compatible reader recovers every committed message and outcome after that released-reader refusal
Incompatible actual broker startup releases custody for compatible restart
knownLimitation: Never open upgraded state with an old binary. The released reader truncates a torn suffix before discovering an unsupported checkpoint; unconditional downgrade non-mutation is false. A future host migration guard must prevent unsupported old-binary startup before it opens authoritative state.
